findings.claim: The round-1 CRITICAL is unresolved in this diff: the change is still projected as COMPLETE/DONE with incremented completion counters while acceptance task 10 (artifact-refiner AND artifact-only adversarial review; verify and archive only after both gates pass) remains open, and the round-2 adversarial gate has not yet passed.
findings.evidence: progress.json still sets "implementation_status": "COMPLETE" and "status": "DONE" with "changes_completed": 3 and "implementation_completed": 3; position.json still shows "status": "COMPLETE" and done 35/63; current-waypoint.json still shows implementationCompleted 35; tasks.md still shows task 10 as "[ ] 10 … (IN_PROGRESS)" and the acceptance criterion reads "verify and archive only after both gates pass". resolution.md admits the defect was not corrected ("The signed control plane rejected a transition from Complete back to InProgress with 409 Conflict, so no generated KBD file was hand-edited"), i.e. the false terminal projection ships as-is and only an out-of-band convention ("Archive remained blocked") prevents it from taking effect.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not archive or transition on the basis of these projections; track the discrepancy as a known-false control-plane record in the phase evidence index (not only in this change's review folder), and correct the projection through whatever signed path exists (e.g., a corrective revision) once task 10's gates actually pass, so progress.json/position.json/current-waypoint.json are not permanently falsified.

findings.evidence: checkpoints/f0578e81.json has "updated_at": "2026-08-29T20:17:10Z" and its own checkpoint record "phase": "execute", "timestamp": "2026-08-29T20:20:05Z", yet embeds iteration_history[0] with "decision": "terminate", "timestamp": "2026-08-29T20:20:06Z" and "phases_completed": ["specify","plan","execute","reflect","persist"]; checkpoints/9100ef56.json (reflect) similarly lacks the persist checkpoint that state.json lists at the same second. resolution.md claims "refiner chronology follows its checkpoints", but the blocking evidence-and-fixture-integrity constraint's traceability is still satisfied only by retroactive rewriting.
findings.suggested_fix: Write each checkpoint file once at its phase boundary with only the state known then; if the toolchain cannot do that, record in decisions.md that checkpoint files are final-state mirrors, not point-in-time snapshots, so future audits do not rely on them as chronological evidence.
